blocks.en: Section 1: Evaluation Criteria & Special Topics

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 掌握 Surface Glass Test 〈660〉 的局限性，以及為什麼需要額外的 Predictive Screening Methods（預測性篩選方法）
blocks.en: Understand the limitations of the Surface Glass Test <660> and why additional predictive screening methods are needed

blocks.zh: 了解三種篩選參數：玻璃內表面視覺/化學特性、溶液中萃取元素、亞可見/可見玻璃微粒，以及對應的分析技術
blocks.en: Understand the three screening parameters (visual/chemical characteristics of the glass inner surface, extracted elements in solution, and subvisible/visible glass particles) and the corresponding analytical techniques

blocks.zh: 能夠設計 Aggressive Screening Conditions（加速篩選條件）和針對特定藥品的篩選策略
blocks.en: Be able to design aggressive screening conditions and drug-product-specific screening strategies

blocks.zh: 理解 ICP-MS（感應耦合電漿質譜）、SEM-EDX（掃描電子顯微鏡-能量分散 X 射線光譜）的分析原理和在脫層評估中的應用
blocks.en: Understand the analytical principles of ICP-MS (inductively coupled plasma-mass spectrometry) and SEM-EDX (scanning electron microscopy-energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy) and their application in delamination assessment

blocks.zh: 掌握風險導向的玻璃容器選擇策略和 CDMO 的供應商管理責任
blocks.en: Master a risk-based strategy for glass container selection and the supplier management responsibilities of a CDMO

blocks.en: Glass Container Sourcing

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器採購的「知情選擇（Informed Selection）」：USP 要求製藥廠商不只是「買一個符合 Type I 規格的西林瓶」，而是要深入了解供應商的製造工藝。以下是必須了解的核心資訊：
blocks.en: "Informed selection" in glass container sourcing: USP expects pharmaceutical manufacturers to do more than "buy a vial that meets the Type I specification"; they must understand the supplier's manufacturing process in depth. The core information you need to know is as follows:

blocks.zh: 玻璃配方：不同供應商的 Type I 硼矽酸鹽組成可能不同，直接影響化學耐久性
blocks.en: Glass formulation: The Type I borosilicate composition may differ between suppliers and directly affects chemical durability

blocks.zh: COE：32–33 vs. 51 expansion，影響熱衝擊耐受性和脫層傾向
blocks.en: COE: 32–33 vs. 51 expansion, which affects thermal shock resistance and delamination tendency

blocks.zh: 是否硫酸銨處理：直接影響表面玻璃試驗結果的解讀方式
blocks.en: Whether ammonium sulfate treated: Directly affects how the Surface Glass Test results should be interpreted

blocks.zh: 多廠址問題：同一型號產品若來自不同生產廠址，玻璃品質可能不同，需要評估等效性
blocks.en: Multiple-site issue: If the same model comes from different manufacturing sites, the glass quality may differ and equivalence must be evaluated

blocks.zh: 「轉換商（Converter）」的角色：有些玻璃製造商只生產玻璃管，由第三方轉換商加工成西林瓶/注射器。轉換商的製造條件（溫度、速度）直接影響脫層風險，必須在合格供應商評估（Vendor Qualification）中涵蓋。
blocks.en: Role of the "converter": Some glass manufacturers produce only glass tubing, and a third-party converter processes it into vials/syringes. The converter's manufacturing conditions (temperature, speed) directly affect delamination risk and must be covered in vendor qualification.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 多廠址風險是 FDA 關注點：FDA 在多次檢查中發現，從同一家玻璃公司不同廠址採購的「同型號」西林瓶，其脫層傾向有顯著差異。原因在於不同廠址的爐具狀況、製造溫度設定、退火曲線等可能不同。如果你的供應商有多個生產地點，你需要分別評估，不能假設「同型號必然等效」。
blocks.en: Multiple-site risk is an FDA focus: In several inspections, FDA found that vials of the "same model" purchased from different sites of the same glass company showed significantly different delamination tendencies. The reason is that furnace condition, forming temperature settings, annealing profile and so on may differ between sites. If your supplier has several production sites, you need to evaluate each one separately and cannot assume that the "same model is necessarily equivalent".

blocks.zh: 製程變更通知（Change Notification）系統：USP 明確要求玻璃製造商建立系統，在製程變更時主動通知客戶。這對製藥廠商非常重要——如果供應商悄悄換了退火曲線或玻璃配方，你可能直到穩定性出現問題才發現。在供應協議（Quality Agreement）中，必須明確要求供應商的變更通知義務。
blocks.en: Change notification system: USP expects glass manufacturers to establish a system that proactively notifies customers of process changes. This is very important for pharmaceutical manufacturers: if the supplier quietly changes the annealing profile or glass formulation, you may not find out until a stability problem appears. The supplier's change notification obligation must be clearly required in the supply agreement (quality agreement).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器採購管理就像採購有機認證食材：你不能只看包裝上的「有機認證」標籤（Surface Glass Test 〈660〉 合格）就放心，還需要知道農場的土壤成分（玻璃配方）、種植方法（製造工藝）、是否用過農藥（硫酸銨處理）、從哪個農場來的（多廠址問題）。真正的品質保障來自對整個供應鏈的深入了解。
blocks.en: Glass container sourcing is like buying certified organic food: you cannot rely on the "organic certified" label on the package alone (passing the Surface Glass Test <660>). You also need to know the soil composition of the farm (glass formulation), the growing methods (manufacturing process), whether pesticides were used (ammonium sulfate treatment), and which farm it came from (multiple-site issue). Real quality assurance comes from a thorough understanding of the whole supply chain.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 準備從一個新的玻璃供應商（已有 Type I 認證）採購西林瓶用於生物製劑注射劑。列出你在供應商合格評鑑（Supplier Qualification）中需要獲取的關鍵技術資訊。
blocks.en: Your CDMO plans to buy vials for a biologic injectable from a new glass supplier (already certified as Type I). List the key technical information you need to obtain during supplier qualification.

blocks.zh: 如果玻璃供應商告知，他們在中國和歐洲的兩個廠址都可以生產你需要的型號，你需要做哪些評估才能接受兩個廠址的供貨？
blocks.en: If the glass supplier tells you that both of their sites, in China and in Europe, can produce the model you need, what evaluations do you need to perform before you can accept supply from both sites?

blocks.zh: Evaluation of the Inner Surface Durability | 內表面耐久性評估
blocks.en: Evaluation of the Inner Surface Durability

blocks.zh: Predictive Screening Methods | 預測性篩選方法
blocks.en: Predictive Screening Methods

blocks.zh: 三個篩選維度的互補性：
blocks.en: The three screening dimensions are complementary:

blocks.zh: USP 設計了三個維度的篩選，因為每個維度偵測的是脫層過程的不同階段：
blocks.en: USP designed screening in three dimensions because each dimension detects a different stage of the delamination process:

blocks.zh: 玻璃內表面特性（DIC 顯微鏡、SIMS）：最早期指標——在任何脫層發生之前，就可以看到表面蝕刻程度和組成深度分布。屬於「超前預警」。
blocks.en: Glass inner surface characteristics (DIC microscopy, SIMS): The earliest indicator. Before any delamination occurs, you can already see the degree of surface etching and the depth profile of the composition. This is an "advance warning".

blocks.zh: 溶液中萃取元素（ICP-MS、ICP-OES）：中期指標——偵測玻璃元素（Si、Na、K、Ca、B 等）在藥液中的溶出量。SiO₂ 濃度上升是腐蝕進展的早期訊號。
blocks.en: Extracted elements in solution (ICP-MS, ICP-OES): The mid-stage indicator. It detects the amount of glass elements (Si, Na, K, Ca, B, etc.) leached into the drug solution. A rising SiO₂ concentration is an early signal of advancing corrosion.

blocks.zh: 玻璃薄片/微粒（SEM-EDX、目視、粒徑分析）：後期指標——直接偵測已脫落的薄片，是脫層發生後的確認。
blocks.en: Glass flakes/particles (SEM-EDX, visual inspection, particle size analysis): The late-stage indicator. It directly detects flakes that have already shed and confirms that delamination has occurred.

blocks.zh: 最理想的評估應同時使用三個維度，而不是只看微粒計數（最後一道防線）。
blocks.en: The ideal evaluation uses all three dimensions together, rather than relying only on particle counts (the last line of defense).

blocks.zh: 分析技術解析 Analytical Techniques
blocks.en: Analytical Techniques

blocks.zh: ICP-MS（感應耦合電漿質譜，Inductively Coupled Plasma–Mass Spectrometry）：
blocks.en: ICP-MS (Inductively Coupled Plasma-Mass Spectrometry):

blocks.zh: 將液體樣品霧化後通入高溫電漿（約 10,000 K），使元素原子化和離子化，再用質譜儀按質荷比（m/z）分析各元素的離子。靈敏度極高（ppb 到 ppt 量級），可同時定量數十種元素（Si、Na、Al、B、Ca、Mg 等）。是偵測玻璃浸出元素的「黃金標準」。
blocks.en: The liquid sample is nebulized and passed into a high-temperature plasma (about 10,000 K), which atomizes and ionizes the elements; a mass spectrometer then analyzes the ions of each element by mass-to-charge ratio (m/z). Sensitivity is extremely high (ppb to ppt level), and dozens of elements (Si, Na, Al, B, Ca, Mg, etc.) can be quantified simultaneously. It is the "gold standard" for detecting elements leached from glass.

blocks.zh: SEM-EDX（掃描電子顯微鏡–能量分散 X 射線光譜，Scanning Electron Microscopy–Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy）：
blocks.en: SEM-EDX (Scanning Electron Microscopy-Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy):

blocks.zh: SEM 提供微米級解析度的形貌圖（可以看到薄片的形狀、大小、表面形態）；EDX 提供薄片的元素組成（確認是否為玻璃，而非其他微粒）。在 OOS 調查中，當發現微粒時，SEM-EDX 可以確認微粒是否為玻璃起源。
blocks.en: SEM provides micrometer-resolution morphology images (showing the shape, size and surface features of flakes); EDX provides the elemental composition of the flakes (confirming whether they are glass rather than other particles). In an OOS investigation, when particles are found, SEM-EDX can confirm whether they are of glass origin.

blocks.zh: Surface Glass Test 〈660〉 的具體局限：
blocks.en: Specific limitations of the Surface Glass Test <660>:

blocks.zh: 萃取介質是水，不能反映實際藥品（有機酸鹽、EDTA）的攻擊性
blocks.en: The extraction medium is water, which does not reflect the aggressiveness of actual drug products (organic acid salts, EDTA)

blocks.zh: 硫酸銨處理後的瓶子可以得到人為降低的鹼溶出值
blocks.en: Vials treated with ammonium sulfate can give artificially lowered alkali leaching values

blocks.zh: 管制玻璃在瓶踵附近（最脆弱的地方）的耐久性低於側壁，但試驗量測的是整體平均值
blocks.en: Tubular glass is less durable near the heel (the most vulnerable area) than on the side wall, but the test measures the overall average

blocks.zh: 通過 Surface Glass Test 不能保證這個玻璃適合特定的高風險配方
blocks.en: Passing the Surface Glass Test does not guarantee that the glass is suitable for a specific high-risk formulation

blocks.zh: 這是為什麼 USP 1660 說 Surface Glass Test 只是「起點（first step）」，而不是終點。
blocks.en: This is why USP 1660 says the Surface Glass Test is only a "first step" and not the end point.

blocks.zh: 在使用 ICP-MS 評估玻璃浸出時，哪些元素的升高是玻璃腐蝕最可靠的早期訊號？為什麼 SiO₂ 濃度特別重要？
blocks.en: When evaluating glass leaching by ICP-MS, which elevated elements are the most reliable early signals of glass corrosion? Why is the SiO₂ concentration particularly important?

blocks.zh: 如果在 SEM-EDX 分析中發現微粒含有高比例的 Si、O、Na 和少量 B，這個微粒最可能是什麼來源？你的結論如何影響後續調查方向？
blocks.en: If SEM-EDX analysis finds that a particle contains high proportions of Si, O and Na and a small amount of B, what is the most likely source of the particle? How does your conclusion affect the direction of the follow-up investigation?

blocks.zh: Aggressive Screening Conditions | 加速篩選條件
blocks.en: Aggressive Screening Conditions

blocks.zh: Screening Strategy for Drug Products | 特定藥品的篩選策略
blocks.en: Screening Strategy for Drug Products

blocks.zh: 兩類篩選條件的用途差異：
blocks.en: The two types of screening conditions serve different purposes:

blocks.zh: 一般性加速篩選（Table 4）：用於「排名比較」——不針對特定產品，而是用標準攻擊性溶液（KCl、檸檬酸鈉、甘氨酸）在加速條件下，比較不同玻璃容器的相對化學耐久性。適用於供應商選擇、玻璃批次間比較、製程變更評估。
blocks.en: General aggressive screening (Table 4): Used for "ranking comparison". It is not directed at a specific product; instead, standard aggressive solutions (KCl, sodium citrate, glycine) are used under accelerated conditions to compare the relative chemical durability of different glass containers. It is suitable for supplier selection, comparison between glass batches and evaluation of process changes.

blocks.zh: 產品特定篩選（Table 5）：用「真實產品」在相關加速條件下測試。因為真實藥品配方的複雜性（多種輔料相互作用）是一般性測試無法模擬的。必須同時設立三組對照（壓力試驗、水對照、藥品對照），才能正確解讀結果。
blocks.en: Product-specific screening (Table 5): The "real product" is tested under relevant accelerated conditions, because the complexity of real drug formulations (interactions among multiple excipients) cannot be simulated by general tests. Three sets of controls (stress test, water control and drug product control) must be set up together in order to interpret the results correctly.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formulas and Calculations

blocks.zh:
加速測試條件的選擇原則（Arrhenius 加速概念）：

目標：用短時間高溫測試預測長時間低溫儲存的效果

典型加速因子（化學反應速率的溫度依賴性）：
溫度每升高 10°C，反應速率約增加 2–3 倍（Q₁₀ rule）

例：
產品儲存條件：5°C，24 個月
加速條件：30°C，相當於模擬大約：
(30-5)/10 = 2.5 倍加速 → Q₁₀ = 2 時，30°C 6 個月 ≈ 5°C 24 個月
（實際加速因子需根據具體反應機制計算）

Table 5 的三組對照設計意義：
壓力試驗 → 確認測試條件夠強（能引發可觀察的脫層）
水對照   → 基準線（排除水本身對玻璃的影響）
藥品對照 → 評估實際配方的影響（=三組差異的來源）
blocks.en:
Principles for selecting accelerated test conditions (Arrhenius acceleration concept):

Goal: use a short, high-temperature test to predict the effect of long-term, low-temperature storage

Typical acceleration factor (temperature dependence of chemical reaction rate):
For every 10°C increase in temperature, the reaction rate increases by about 2–3 times (Q₁₀ rule)

Example:
Product storage condition: 5°C, 24 months
Accelerated condition: 30°C, which approximately simulates:
(30-5)/10 = 2.5 → with Q₁₀ = 2, 30°C for 6 months ≈ 5°C for 24 months
(the actual acceleration factor must be calculated from the specific reaction mechanism)

Meaning of the three-control design in Table 5:
Stress test → confirms the test conditions are strong enough (able to induce observable delamination)
Water control → baseline (excludes the effect of water itself on the glass)
Drug product control → evaluates the effect of the actual formulation (= the source of the difference among the three sets)

blocks.zh: 「假陽性」的風險：Table 4 的一般性加速篩選條件非常嚴苛（121°C KCl、80°C 檸檬酸鈉），在這些條件下顯示脫層的玻璃，不一定代表在實際產品中也會脫層。如果直接用 Table 4 條件測試藥品，可能因溫度過高損壞藥品，或因條件不相關而得到毫無意義的結果。USP 明確警告：「Table 4 的條件太嚴苛，不能用於評估特定產品與特定玻璃的相容性。」
blocks.en: Risk of "false positives": The general aggressive screening conditions in Table 4 are very severe (KCl at 121°C, sodium citrate at 80°C). Glass that shows delamination under these conditions will not necessarily delaminate in the actual product. If the Table 4 conditions are applied directly to a drug product, the product may be damaged by the excessive temperature, or the results may be meaningless because the conditions are not relevant. USP warns explicitly: "The Table 4 conditions are too severe to be used for evaluating the compatibility of a specific product with a specific glass."

blocks.zh: 脫層的「警示指標（Indicators）」：在篩選研究中，以下任何一個出現都應高度重視：①瓶踵上方的點蝕（pitting）——最早期的表面腐蝕訊號；②溶液中 SiO₂ 濃度升高——溶矽訊號；③亞可見微粒數量增加；④溶液 pH 變化（如果沒有足夠緩衝能力）。
blocks.en: "Indicators" of delamination: In a screening study, the appearance of any of the following should be taken very seriously: (1) pitting above the heel, the earliest signal of surface corrosion; (2) a rising SiO₂ concentration in solution, a sign of silicon dissolution; (3) an increase in the number of subvisible particles; (4) a change in solution pH (if buffering capacity is insufficient).

blocks.zh: Table 5 的三組對照就像材料耐腐蝕測試的標準設計：①壓力試驗（放在鹽水裡）確認方法夠靈敏；②水對照（放在蒸餾水裡）看材料本身的基礎腐蝕率；③實際環境對照（放在真實化學品裡）才是你真正要知道的答案。三組缺一不可，因為「看似中性的產品+特定溫度」可能遠比單純的水更腐蝕——正如中性的檸檬酸鈉溶液對玻璃的攻擊性相當於強鹼。
blocks.en: The three controls in Table 5 are like the standard design of a material corrosion resistance test: (1) the stress test (immersion in salt water) confirms the method is sensitive enough; (2) the water control (immersion in distilled water) shows the baseline corrosion rate of the material itself; (3) the control in the actual environment (immersion in the real chemical) is the answer you really want. None of the three can be omitted, because a "seemingly neutral product + a specific temperature" can be far more corrosive than plain water, just as a neutral sodium citrate solution attacks glass as aggressively as a strong alkali.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 玻璃相容性篩選流程建議：
blocks.en: Suggested CDMO glass compatibility screening workflow:

blocks.zh: 第一步（技術轉移前）：使用 Table 4 的一般性加速篩選，對備選玻璃供應商進行排名，初步篩除品質差的供應商。
blocks.en: Step 1 (before tech transfer): Use the general aggressive screening in Table 4 to rank the candidate glass suppliers and screen out poor-quality suppliers at an early stage.

blocks.zh: 第二步（配方確定後，穩定性前）：使用 Table 5 的三組對照設計，以實際藥品配方在加速條件下（通常 30–40°C，4–12 週）進行篩選。監測 SiO₂ 濃度、亞可見微粒（USP <788>）、目視外觀、pH。
blocks.en: Step 2 (after the formulation is fixed, before stability): Use the three-control design in Table 5 and screen with the actual drug formulation under accelerated conditions (typically 30–40°C, 4–12 weeks). Monitor SiO₂ concentration, subvisible particles (USP <788>), visual appearance and pH.

blocks.zh: 第三步（穩定性研究中）：在長期穩定性樣本（5°C 或 25°C）中定期監測微粒和浸出元素，確認加速篩選結果與真實條件的相關性。
blocks.en: Step 3 (during stability studies): Periodically monitor particles and leached elements in long-term stability samples (5°C or 25°C) to confirm that the accelerated screening results correlate with real conditions.

blocks.zh: 設計一個含 10 mg/mL 單株抗體的注射劑（50 mM 琥珀酸鈉，pH 5.5，儲存於 5°C，貨架期 24 個月）的玻璃相容性篩選方案。應選用什麼加速條件？需要監測哪些指標？
blocks.en: Design a glass compatibility screening plan for an injectable containing 10 mg/mL monoclonal antibody (50 mM sodium succinate, pH 5.5, stored at 5°C, 24-month shelf life). What accelerated conditions should be used? What parameters need to be monitored?

blocks.zh: 在篩選研究中，「壓力試驗組」沒有出現任何脫層指標，「藥品對照組」也沒有。這是否代表這個玻璃一定安全？你還需要確認什麼？
blocks.en: In a screening study, the "stress test group" shows no delamination indicators, and neither does the "drug product control group". Does this mean the glass is definitely safe? What else do you need to confirm?

blocks.zh: Conclusions & Mitigation Strategies | 結論與風險緩解策略
blocks.en: Conclusions & Mitigation Strategies

blocks.zh: USP 1660 的核心訊息總結：
blocks.en: Summary of the core message of USP 1660:

blocks.zh: 不充分：只做 Surface Glass Test 〈660〉
blocks.en: Inadequate: Surface Glass Test <660> only

blocks.zh: 推薦：加上通用加速篩選（供應商比較）
blocks.en: Recommended: add general aggressive screening (supplier comparison)

blocks.zh: 最佳：加上產品特定篩選（3組對照）+ 穩定性監測
blocks.en: Best: add product-specific screening (3 controls) + stability monitoring

blocks.zh: 對於高風險配方（有機酸鹽、EDTA、高 pH、高離子強度），必須達到最高層級的評估。這不只是 USP 建議，更是保護患者和保護公司商業利益的必要行動。
blocks.en: For high-risk formulations (organic acid salts, EDTA, high pH, high ionic strength), the highest level of evaluation must be reached. This is not just a USP recommendation but a necessary action to protect patients and the company's commercial interests.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 風險緩解策略（Mitigation Strategies）
blocks.en: Key Notes: Mitigation Strategies

blocks.zh: 如果篩選結果顯示高脫層風險，可採取以下緩解措施：
blocks.en: If screening results show a high delamination risk, the following mitigation measures can be taken:

blocks.zh: 容器選擇：換用模製玻璃（比管制玻璃脫層風險低）；選擇 32–33 膨脹 COE 的管制玻璃（更穩定）；考慮塑膠容器（COP/COC 環烯烴聚合物，完全消除玻璃脫層風險）
blocks.en: Container selection: Switch to molded glass (lower delamination risk than tubular glass); choose tubular glass with 32–33 expansion COE (more stable); consider plastic containers (COP/COC cyclic olefin polymers, which eliminate the glass delamination risk completely)

blocks.zh: 配方調整：更換緩衝劑類型（如用組氨酸替代檸檬酸鹽）；降低緩衝劑濃度；移除 EDTA；調整 pH 至更安全範圍
blocks.en: Formulation adjustment: Change the buffer type (for example, histidine instead of citrate); lower the buffer concentration; remove EDTA; adjust the pH to a safer range

blocks.zh: 製程調整：避免終端滅菌（改用無菌過濾充填）；優化除熱原條件（降低溫度或減少循環次數）
blocks.en: Process adjustment: Avoid terminal sterilization (use sterile filtration and filling instead); optimize depyrogenation conditions (lower temperature or fewer cycles)

blocks.zh: 玻璃塗層：某些供應商提供 SiO₂ 塗層的玻璃容器（如 Corning Valor Glass™），具有更高的化學耐久性
blocks.en: Glass coating: Some suppliers offer glass containers with an SiO₂ coating (such as Corning Valor Glass™), which have higher chemical durability

blocks.zh: 玻璃脫層的緩解策略就像醫療決策的三層防線：第一層是選對材料（選更耐用的玻璃，或改用塑膠容器——相當於「換一個更健康的生活環境」）；第二層是調整配方（移除攻擊性因子——相當於「改變飲食習慣」）；第三層是優化製程（避免增加風險的製程步驟——相當於「避免危險行為」）。最理想是在開發早期就把第一、二層做好，而不是等到有問題才補救。
blocks.en: Mitigation of glass delamination is like the three layers of defense in medical decision-making: the first layer is choosing the right material (choose more durable glass, or switch to a plastic container, equivalent to "moving to a healthier living environment"); the second layer is adjusting the formulation (remove aggressive factors, equivalent to "changing eating habits"); the third layer is optimizing the process (avoid process steps that add risk, equivalent to "avoiding risky behavior"). Ideally the first and second layers are put in place early in development, rather than remedied after problems arise.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的三道防線決策框架：
blocks.en: Three-lines-of-defense decision framework for CDMOs:

blocks.zh: 早期開發（IND 前）：識別配方高風險因子 → 立即規劃玻璃相容性篩選 → 儘早排除不適合的玻璃選項
blocks.en: Early development (pre-IND): Identify high-risk formulation factors → plan glass compatibility screening immediately → rule out unsuitable glass options as early as possible

blocks.zh: IND 後/臨床階段：完成產品特定篩選 → 建立玻璃供應商的監測趨勢（批間 Surface Glass Test 趨勢圖）
blocks.en: Post-IND/clinical stage: Complete product-specific screening → establish trend monitoring of the glass supplier (batch-to-batch Surface Glass Test trend chart)

blocks.zh: 商業化後：年度玻璃批次評估 → 變更管理（換供應商、換廠址必須重新評估） → OOS 調查程序中包含玻璃微粒的 SEM-EDX 確認
blocks.en: After commercialization: Annual glass batch evaluation → change management (a change of supplier or site must be re-evaluated) → include SEM-EDX confirmation of glass particles in the OOS investigation procedure

blocks.zh: 一個含有 EDTA（0.01% w/v）的眼用注射液，使用 Type I 管制玻璃西林瓶，在 12 個月穩定性樣本中發現亞可見微粒數量有上升趨勢。請設計根本原因調查計畫，並列出可能的緩解措施。
blocks.en: An ophthalmic injectable containing EDTA (0.01% w/v) in Type I tubular glass vials shows a rising trend in subvisible particle counts in 12-month stability samples. Design a root cause investigation plan and list possible mitigation measures.

blocks.zh: 如果一個高 pH（pH 9.2）的眼科製劑必須使用玻璃容器（因為塑料容器有吸附問題），你會建議哪些組合措施來降低脫層風險？（至少提出三種策略）
blocks.en: If a high-pH (pH 9.2) ophthalmic formulation must use a glass container (because plastic containers have an adsorption problem), what combination of measures would you recommend to reduce the delamination risk? (Propose at least three strategies.)

blocks.zh: Container Selection Decision Framework | 容器選擇決策框架
blocks.en: Container Selection Decision Framework

blocks.zh: 「玻璃容器可能不適合某些配方」的重要性：USP 明確指出，如果風險因子累積到一定程度，正確的選擇可能是「不用玻璃容器」。這是一個需要勇氣的科學決策。替代方案包括：
blocks.en: The importance of recognizing that "glass containers may not be suitable for some formulations": USP states explicitly that if risk factors accumulate to a certain degree, the right choice may be "not to use a glass container". This is a scientific decision that takes courage. Alternatives include:

blocks.zh: COP/COC（環烯烴聚合物容器）：完全消除玻璃脫層風險，但有吸附性和特定溶出物問題，需要另外的 E&L 評估
blocks.en: COP/COC (cyclic olefin polymer containers): Completely eliminate the glass delamination risk, but have adsorption and specific leachable issues and require a separate E&L assessment

blocks.zh: 不銹鋼容器：適用於某些特殊製劑
blocks.en: Stainless steel containers: Suitable for certain special formulations

blocks.zh: 配方重設計：移除攻擊性輔料，使配方能夠安全使用玻璃容器
blocks.en: Formulation redesign: Remove the aggressive excipients so that the formulation can be used safely in glass containers

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 歷史教訓
blocks.en: Key Notes: Lessons from History

blocks.zh: 真實召回案例的啟示：2010–2012 年間，多家製藥公司因注射劑中發現玻璃脫層薄片而被迫召回產品，涉及數百萬支西林瓶。這些案例的共同特點：①大多數是管制玻璃容器；②配方包含高濃度有機酸鹽緩衝劑；③在進行商業化生產前，沒有進行充分的玻璃相容性篩選。
blocks.en: Lessons from real recall cases: Between 2010 and 2012, several pharmaceutical companies were forced to recall products because glass delamination flakes were found in injectables, involving millions of vials. The common features of these cases: (1) most were tubular glass containers; (2) the formulations contained high concentrations of organic acid salt buffers; (3) adequate glass compatibility screening was not performed before commercial production.

blocks.zh: 這些召回直接推動了 FDA 和 USP 對玻璃脫層問題的關注，最終促成了 USP 1660 的制訂（2013 年首次發布）。對 CDMO 的警示：「歷史教訓不是用來重複的。」
blocks.en: These recalls directly drove FDA and USP attention to the glass delamination problem and ultimately led to the development of USP 1660 (first published in 2013). A warning for CDMOs: "Lessons from history are not meant to be repeated."

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 接到一個含有 100 mM 葡萄糖酸鈉（pH 7.8）的注射劑委託，客戶堅持要用 Type I 管制玻璃西林瓶。你會如何向客戶說明風險，並建議合理的評估計畫？
blocks.en: Your CDMO receives a request for an injectable containing 100 mM sodium gluconate (pH 7.8), and the customer insists on Type I tubular glass vials. How would you explain the risk to the customer and propose a reasonable evaluation plan?

blocks.zh: 如果你的篩選研究結果顯示，供應商 A 的玻璃在加速條件下出現微粒，供應商 B 沒有，但供應商 B 的價格高出 30%。你如何向管理層呈現這個數據，並爭取選擇品質更好的供應商？（提示：從患者安全和商業風險角度）
blocks.en: If your screening study shows that glass from Supplier A produces particles under accelerated conditions and Supplier B does not, but Supplier B's price is 30% higher, how do you present this data to management and make the case for choosing the better-quality supplier? (Hint: from the standpoint of patient safety and commercial risk.)

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Surface Glass Test 〈660〉 是必做的起點篩查，但對高風險配方不足夠——硫酸銨處理可人為降低鹼溶出值，且試驗不考慮實際藥品的攻擊性
blocks.en: The Surface Glass Test <660> is a mandatory starting screen but is not sufficient for high-risk formulations: ammonium sulfate treatment can artificially lower the alkali leaching value, and the test does not take into account the aggressiveness of the actual drug product

blocks.zh: 預測性篩選應評估三個維度：玻璃內表面特性（DIC 顯微鏡/SIMS）、溶液中萃取元素（ICP-MS，特別是 SiO₂）、玻璃薄片/微粒（SEM-EDX 確認組成）
blocks.en: Predictive screening should evaluate three dimensions: glass inner surface characteristics (DIC microscopy/SIMS), extracted elements in solution (ICP-MS, especially SiO₂), and glass flakes/particles (composition confirmed by SEM-EDX)

blocks.zh: 兩類加速篩選條件：一般性加速篩選（Table 4，用於供應商排名比較）和產品特定篩選（Table 5，三組對照設計，反映真實產品風險）；兩者目的不同，不可混用
blocks.en: There are two types of aggressive screening conditions: general aggressive screening (Table 4, for supplier ranking and comparison) and product-specific screening (Table 5, three-control design, reflecting real product risk); their purposes differ and they must not be mixed

blocks.zh: 高風險配方的緩解策略：容器替換（模製玻璃、COP/COC 容器）、配方調整（換緩衝劑、移除 EDTA）、製程優化（避免終端滅菌）——最理想在開發早期決定
blocks.en: Mitigation strategies for high-risk formulations: container replacement (molded glass, COP/COC containers), formulation adjustment (change the buffer, remove EDTA) and process optimization (avoid terminal sterilization); ideally decided early in development

blocks.zh: CDMO 的責任：在技術轉移時識別高風險配方因子，主動規劃玻璃相容性篩選；建立玻璃供應商質量監測程序；OOS 調查中納入玻璃微粒的 SEM-EDX 確認
blocks.en: CDMO responsibilities: identify high-risk formulation factors at tech transfer and proactively plan glass compatibility screening; establish a quality monitoring procedure for glass suppliers; include SEM-EDX confirmation of glass particles in OOS investigations
